complexity.notes: The counter variable i is incremented but never used and should be removed. The set stores ListNode objects, which use Python's default identity hash (based on object address), so lookups are O(1) even in the worst case; a Floyd's tortoise-and-hare approach would achieve O(1) space.
complexity.summary: Traverses the list while storing each visited node in a set; returns True if a node is revisited (a cycle) and False if the traversal reaches null.
